points.text: Removal of legacy icons might affect plugins or custom scripts that rely on these specific icon paths.
points.label: useful

points.text: The changes in icon usage are not directly covered by existing tests, which could lead to unnoticed UI regressions.
points.label: useful

points.text: Changes might impact other parts of the system that depend on the old icon paths or classes.
points.label: useful

points.text: Consider providing a deprecation period where both old and new icons are available, or document the changes clearly for plugin developers.
points.label: useful

points.text: Add UI tests to verify that the new icons render correctly in all affected views and that there are no visual regressions.
points.label: useful

points.text: Conduct thorough integration testing to ensure that no other parts of the system are adversely affected by these changes.
points.label: useful
